_about: Hand-picked stills per trip, in display order; the first is the hero. `commons` is the Wikimedia Commons file title. The licence and author are read from Commons at build time. Optional `focus` [x,y] (0-1) steers the automatic landscape crop; `crop` [left,top,width,height] (0-1) sets it exactly.
